[operator-attested] Mutation proof for criterion: "Mutation proof restores local-dedup-first ordering and makes the held-out restart regression fail."

This evidence is inherently an executed development experiment rather than a permanent production behavior. Using the final held-out oracle `tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_accepted_rerun_survives_restart_via_gerrit_reconcile`, the defective local-dedup-first ordering was temporarily restored in `src/rebar/review_bot/reconcile.py`. Running the exact test with `pytest tests/unit/test_review_bot.py::test_accepted_rerun_survives_restart_via_gerrit_reconcile -q` then failed at the contractual postcondition because reconciliation returned `reviewed: 0` instead of recovering the owed review. Restoring the Gerrit-first implementation and rerunning the same command passed. The final committed test asserts the observable restart-recovery contract and does not encode the intentionally defective mutation in the repository.
